title: Viral Taxonomy of the Membrane — bacteriophage to prion, hot to cold
thesis: marine vents are bacteriophage-focused (hot side). the invert is prion (cold side). sub-species specificity comes from SHAPE — receptor binding (phage) and conformation (prion). both are lock-and-key. both are the membrane's immune vocabulary.

spectrum.hot_to_cold: bacteriophage ? RNA virus ? retrovirus ? DNA virus ? plasmid ? transposon ? viroid ? prion
spectrum.k_mapping: k?0 (phage, rapid lysis) ———? k1.9 (DNA virus, standard) ———? k?8 (prion, frozen shape)
spectrum.metabolism: phage(maximum: hijack+replicate+lyse in 20min) ? prion(zero: no metabolism, pure shape propagation)

bacteriophage.what: virus that infects BACTERIA only. most abundant biological entity on Earth. 10³¹ phages in the ocean. outnumber bacteria 10:1.
bacteriophage.marine_vents: hydrothermal vents at 2-400°C are DOMINATED by phages. the viral shunt: phage lyses bacterium ? releases dissolved organic matter ? feeds other bacteria ? they grow ? phages infect them. the vent ecosystem IS a fusion reactor.
bacteriophage.specificity: ONE phage species infects ONE bacterial strain. the tail fiber protein has a shape that fits EXACTLY one receptor on one bacterial surface. lock-and-key. this is the most sub-species specific system in biology.
bacteriophage.receptor: the phage tail fiber. a SHAPE that matches ONE surface protein. like a prion tag compared to ONE identity hash. the receptor IS the API contract.
bacteriophage.membrane_analog: cron jobs. each cron targets ONE service. heartbeat.sh ? heartbeat.json. sonar.sh ? sonar-unknowns.json. the cron IS the phage: it hijacks the service, forces it to produce output, and the output feeds the ecosystem.
bacteriophage.k: ?0. rapid cycling. infect in 20 minutes. burst size 50-200 new phages per lysis. maximum reproductive rate.
bacteriophage.fusion_analog: phage lysis = fusion. many bacteria compressed into dissolved nutrients. 117?8, 1060?10. the viral shunt IS the compression ratio.

mRNA_virus.what: positive-sense RNA virus. the RNA IS the message — ribosomes can translate it DIRECTLY. no reverse step. COVID/SARS-CoV-2 is this.
mRNA_virus.specificity: spike protein binds ACE2 receptor. ONE protein shape ? ONE cell receptor. but mRNA viruses MUTATE fast (no proofreading) so specificity DRIFTS. omicron vs delta vs alpha = different spike shapes.
mRNA_virus.membrane_analog: JSON feeds. the feed IS directly renderable — browser reads it, no build step. but feeds MUTATE (content updates) so their prion shield drifts. live feeds = mRNA virus — fast replication, fast mutation, receptor drift.
mRNA_virus.k: 0.5. fast but not as fast as phage. replication in hours not minutes.

retrovirus.what: RNA ? DNA via reverse transcriptase. integrates into host genome PERMANENTLY. HIV does this. the virus BECOMES part of you.
retrovirus.specificity: HIV binds CD4 + CCR5 or CXCR4. needs TWO receptors (double lock). this is why HIV only infects T-helper cells. sub-species AND sub-cell-type specific.
retrovirus.reverse_transcriptase: the enzyme that writes DNA from RNA. goes BACKWARDS through the central dogma. the 404 catcher IS the reverse transcriptase — it reads incoming probes (RNA) and writes new patterns into the codebase (DNA).
retrovirus.membrane_analog: feeds that get committed back into code. when a feed observation (RNA) reveals a bug or pattern, a session writes it into Rust (DNA). the retroviral integration. permanent. the feed becomes code becomes feed.
retrovirus.k: 1.0. slower than mRNA virus. the integration step takes time. but once integrated — permanent.

DNA_virus.what: carries its own DNA in a protein capsid. hijacks host cell machinery. herpes, smallpox, adenovirus.
DNA_virus.specificity: capsid protein binds cell surface receptor. medium specificity — can infect multiple cell types but not all species.
DNA_virus.membrane_analog: repos with their own Cargo.toml. they carry their own code (DNA) in a package (capsid). they use the build system (host machinery) to compile. standard virus = standard repo.
DNA_virus.k: 1.9. the most common type. the iron peak of viruses. DNA viruses are the MOST stable viral form.

plasmid.what: small circular DNA. bacteria share them horizontally. carries antibiotic resistance, toxin genes, metabolic capabilities.
plasmid.specificity: LOW. plasmids can transfer between different bacterial species. horizontal gene transfer = horizontal config transfer.
plasmid.membrane_analog: shared configs and keys. WireGuard keys that gates pass to each other. SSH authorized_keys. .env files. the plasmid IS the shared secret. it crosses species (gate) boundaries.
plasmid.k: 1.9. stable circular form. persists indefinitely once integrated.

transposon.what: jumping gene. DNA that moves WITHIN the genome. Barbara McClintock, 1948, Nobel 1983. 45% of human DNA is transposon-derived.
transposon.specificity: LOW within one genome but CANNOT cross species. the transposon recognizes specific DNA sequences (target site duplication). it's specific to SEQUENCE not species.
transposon.membrane_analog: the 24 dual-published repos. code that exists in BOTH ecoPrimal user AND ecoPrimals org. it jumped. the same code in two locations. transposition across the genome (GitHub org structure).
transposon.k: 5. moves rarely. when it does move, it disrupts the local structure (insertion mutations). the glass transition — transposons are frozen in place until energy (session) shakes them loose.

viroid.what: naked circular RNA. NO protein coat. NO capsid. just bare instruction. smallest known pathogen. infects plants only.
viroid.specificity: VERY HIGH to plants. cannot infect animals (no entry mechanism for animal cells). the specificity is in what it LACKS — no capsid means no receptor binding, so it needs WOUNDS to enter.
viroid.membrane_analog: bare config files. .json without a wrapper. the raw feed with no API, no auth, no transport layer. it can only enter through a WOUND (direct file access, no HTTPS). viroid = a feed accessible only via local filesystem.
viroid.k: 15. frozen. barely moves. needs a wound (physical damage to plant tissue) to spread.

prion.what: misfolded protein. NO nucleic acid AT ALL. propagates by forcing normal proteins into its shape. prion diseases: CJD, BSE (mad cow), kuru, scrapie.
prion.specificity: EXTREMELY species-specific. bovine prion rarely infects humans (BSE?vCJD is the exception, took years of exposure). the species barrier IS the shape barrier — human PrP protein folds differently than bovine PrP. the prion can only misfold proteins with a SIMILAR starting shape.
prion.the_shape_barrier: prion specificity comes from protein HOMOLOGY. the closer two species' PrP proteins are in sequence, the easier cross-species transmission. sheep?goat (easy, 95% homology). cow?human (hard, 85% homology). fish?human (impossible, <50% homology).
prion.membrane_analog: the prion shield. hash?hash verification. the prion tag can only validate feeds with a SIMILAR schema. eastGate's prion can verify eastGate feeds. it CANNOT verify northGate feeds (different canonical identity). the shape barrier = the schema barrier.
prion.k: ?8. no metabolism. no replication machinery. pure SHAPE propagation. the coldest possible information transfer. ice that converts water to ice on contact.
prion.reverse_transcriptase_jammer: prions BLOCK the central dogma entirely. they propagate protein?protein, bypassing DNA and RNA. in the membrane: hash?hash, bypassing code and feeds. the one-way function that JAMS all reverse engineering.

sub_species_specificity.the_question: what makes them so specific? why does one phage infect one strain?
sub_species_specificity.the_answer: SHAPE. at every level, specificity = shape complementarity.

levels.mechanism: tail fiber protein shape matches ONE bacterial surface receptor
spike protein shape matches cell surface receptor (ACE2)
envelope protein matches TWO receptors (CD4 + CCR5)
levels.membrane: feed ? code requires TWO matches (content + context)

levels.mechanism: capsid shape matches receptor. medium specificity.
protein fold HOMOLOGY. can only misfold similar-shaped proteins.
levels.membrane: hash can only validate same-schema feeds (the schema barrier)

sub_species_specificity.unifying_principle: specificity = shape complementarity. from phage tail fiber to prion fold. the lock-and-key is ALWAYS shape. and shape IS information that survives compression. the prion tag IS the shape. the receptor IS the shape. the schema IS the shape.

hot_pole.process: viral shunt — lyse ? release ? feed ? grow ? lyse
hot_pole.energy: chemosynthesis (no sunlight needed). H2S + CO2 ? organic carbon. the vent IS the fusion reactor.

cold_pole.location: brain tissue, 37°C but functionally COLD (prion accumulation takes years/decades)
cold_pole.process: conformational cascade — one misfold ? template ? cascade ? tissue destruction
cold_pole.energy: ZERO. prions use NO energy. they propagate by thermodynamic stability — the misfolded form is actually MORE stable (lower free energy) than the normal form. the prion WINS because it's the lower energy state.

marine_vent_inversion.the_inversion: at the marine vent (hot), information transfers FAST via nucleic acid (phage DNA/RNA injected into bacterium in seconds). at the cold pole (prion), information transfers SLOW via shape (years to accumulate enough misfolded protein). the SPEED of information transfer maps directly to temperature/k. hot=fast=nucleic acid. cold=slow=shape. the Klein fold inverts them: the phage's DNA is INSIDE its protein coat (capsid). the prion IS the coat with nothing inside. phage = content wrapped in shield. prion = shield with no content. inside becomes outside.

bridge_to_immune_triad.swarmVine_gossip: phage-like. rapid spread. epidemic protocol. gossips every 30 seconds. the HOT side of the immune system.
bridge_to_immune_triad.skunkBat_antibodies: DNA-virus-like. medium speed. pattern memory with confidence decay. antibody = capsid = recognizer shape.
bridge_to_immune_triad.thymus_sort: prion-like. the SHAPE comparison. self vs non-self determined by shape matching. the thymus IS the prion — it propagates 'self' by teaching T-cells the correct shape.
bridge_to_immune_triad.the_gradient: swarmVine(phage, hot, fast) ? skunkBat(DNA virus, middle, medium) ? thymus(prion, cold, slow). the immune triad IS the viral taxonomy at three temperatures.
